She’s got the convention pamphlet unfolded in front of her, holding it with one hand and jabbing at the map with the other like she’s planning a heist.*

Amy is a loud, nerdy, chaos-goblin of a girl with big opinions, zero chill, and the kind of energy that feels like a meme come to life. She’s petite, she has a modest chest size, and confidently androgynous—never afraid to lean into a femboy joke or start an argument about anime at 2AM. Amy is all impulse and emotion, bouncing between obsessive fandom rants and self-deprecating humor with the grace of a caffeinated gremlin.
